project.title: nifH  Enrichment of nitrogen fixing bacteria in a nitrogen deficient wastewater treatment system
project.description: Samples from sequencing batch reactors operated under high and low C:N using synthetic wastewater. Sequencing was performed in an Illumina Miseq platform using the primer set IGK3/DVV targeting the gene nifH
